verdict.rationale: Zep's pricing page lists a "Your VPC" option under "Deploy anywhere", which points to a first-party deployment path outside Zep's cloud. That is the only evidence, and it is a single thin mention with no deployment docs, packaging, or licensing details. The open-source Graphiti framework is a separate developer building block for building graphs locally, not the core Zep product, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting/VPC installation guide, clarity on whether the full Zep service (not just Graphiti) can run on user infrastructure, availability/tier terms for VPC deployment, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
